body:
I first found this medication when I had terrible migraines from the meds my doctor put me on for Postpartum Psychosis.  They were debilitating and I had 2 kids to take care of.  My doctor prescribed Fioricet and it was like magic. I took 2 pills and my headache was gone, if I took 3 it gave me a nice warm body buzz that just made me feel good.
It is now 1 year later and I still take Fioricet at least 3 times a week.  I have never experienced withdraws or rebound headaches like others have reported.  Now I order the medication from an online pharmacy so I don't have to pay for a doctor visit.  It is pretty inexpensive and easy to obtain.
Basic chain of events:
:00 - I take 3 pills on an empty stomach with water.  They stick a little and taste TERRIBLE, next time will take with juice or soda.
:15 - feeling it start to kick in.  Throbbing in my head is dulling and my body is starting to feel relaxed and 'fuzzy'.
:25 - my headache is almost gone and I am feeling nice.  Going to drink a cup of coffee for some extra caffeine.
:40 - drank my coffee and now I am feeling nice.  Buzzed, no headache and and a very nice mood.  Think I might clean up or something since the baby just went down for a nap.
1:30 - Still feeling pretty nice, cleaned up around the house now I'm getting some work done on the computer.  Might take another one just to keep the buzz going a little.
2:00 - Took another one and it brought my buzzy feeling back bit.  I feel really great, going to take the baby for a walk.
3:00 - Buzz is subsiding, still not headache.  Gonna make a snack and get my older son from the bus stop.
3:30 - Effects of meds have worn off, but still no rebound headache.  Another cup of coffee since I am feeling a little sluggish.
